read_kwargs._comment: No BOM (file starts with 'Faci'). No embedded newlines, no Unnamed/index columns, no trailing empty columns, no thousands separators. Naive pd.read_csv gives the correct 323460x46 shape but silently coerces Latitude/Longitude to object and S8_emp/S9_emp to float; read as str and cast explicitly.

row_count_explanation: wc -l reports 323461 = 1 header line + 323460 data rows; the file is newline-terminated. The csv module yields exactly 323460 data records, every one with exactly 46 fields, so there are no embedded newlines and no ragged rows. The brief's stated 323,461 rows is the wc -l count and is one too high.

duplicates.method: exact = pandas .duplicated() over all 46 columns, full population. near_dupe = exact-match key on normalised name (NFKD->ascii, lowercase, non-alnum->space, collapse whitespace) + lat/lon rounded to 4 decimals (~11 m). NO SAMPLING - all 323,460 rows. This is a blocking-key count, not fuzzy string matching, so it is a LOWER BOUND on true duplication.
duplicates.dominant_cause: 93.69% of the 62,300 repeated Facility IDs are groups where 24/7 takes both 'yes' and 'no'. Dropping the 24/7 column and de-duplicating collapses 323,460 rows to 261,905 (61,555 rows eliminated), after which only 3,146 ids remain repeated.

shared_coordinate_fallback.worst: 26.917858,75.801292 is shared by 9,870 rows spanning 28 Rajasthan districts
shared_coordinate_fallback.note: 51.1% of rows share their exact coordinate pair with at least one other row. Many are district/city centroid fallbacks, not real facility points.

candidate_primary_key.verdict: Facility ID is NOT a primary key of this file as delivered, but it IS the natural entity key: 62,298 of the 62,300 repeated-id groups carry the same hospital_name, and only 1 group spans two states. After collapsing the 24/7 fan-out it identifies 258,756 facilities. Use (Facility ID) as the source entity key and treat the file as having a broken grain, not colliding ids.

coded_vocabularies._proof: For each of the 25 M*/S*_emp columns, the row set {flag==1} is EXACTLY equal to the row set {token present in merged_specialties} - zero rows in either symmetric difference, across all 323,460 rows. See scripts/05_codebook_verify.py.

er_readiness.notes: name+geo+district blocking is viable on 99.46% of rows. The real risk is not missing fields, it is FALSE geo precision: 51.1% of rows share an exact coordinate pair with another row and 6.86% sit on a coordinate shared by >=50 rows, so geo proximity alone will over-merge. Address is 100% populated and carries a 6-digit pincode on 323,454 rows - extract it, it is a better second blocking key than coordinates. No phone/email/website/registration-number column exists.

coverage_warning.note: This dataset is the project spine by volume but it is NOT a complete national register. Odisha has 11 rows and Tamil Nadu 2,567 against Uttar Pradesh's 62,801. Do not compute national coverage statistics from it.

pii.note: No phone, email or dedicated person-name column. The four 'verifier' columns are colour tiers, not people. However hospital_name contains individual practitioner names on many rows (e.g. 'DR GAURAV MISHRA', 'DR K K GUPTA'), which is indirect personal data in a sole-practitioner context.
